title: Automate changelog and onboard aurora-x-13b v2.1 (perf profiles + metadata)
author: Priya Singh
description: This PR adds Aurora-X 13B v2.1 to the model registry with validated performance profiles and introduces an automated changelog/release-notes generator for model onboarding. Motivation: onboarding has become repetitive and error-prone (manual release notes + perf profile additions). This change reduces human error, ensures consistent release notes, and wires a lightweight CI job to fail if perf deltas exceed thresholds. Key parts: 1) model metadata and manifest for aurora-x-13b v2.1, 2) perf profiles (latency/cost/kv-cache behavior) and baseline artifacts, 3) changelog generator script that collects model metadata + perf diffs and produces a release-notes fragment, 4) CI integration that runs perf-diff check and publishes the generated fragment as an artifact for the release pipeline. Checklist: - [x] Add model manifest and metadata (model id, architecture, tokenizer, quantization recommendations) - [x] Add performance profile YAML (microbench and example histograms) - [x] Implement changelog generator script (tools/changelog-generator.py) - [x] Add unit + integration tests for registry automation - [x] CI job to run perf diffs and produce release notes fragment - [x] Docs: brief how-to for oncall/RELEASE process Implementation notes: the metadata schema is bumped to v2.1 to include an optional "quantization_recommendation" field (backwards-compatible). The perf profiles include measured p95/p50 latencies for common sequence lengths and a simple cost-per-token estimate used by the console. The changelog generator compares the incoming perf profile to the latest published profile for the same model-family and flags % deltas exceeding thresholds (configurable). If the threshold is exceeded, the CI job fails and posts a summary to the PR; otherwise a release-notes fragment is attached as a build artifact. Rollout plan: merged to main behind a feature-flag (registry.changelog_automation_enabled). We will watch the first 5 onboardings and iterate on thresholds and text formatting. Related: ENG-12904 (automation initiative) and PM-842 (release workflow improvements).
